entries.name: Rabaul
entries.note: City (town): former provincial capital on Simpson Harbour, base for volcano, WWII and dive sights; Wikivoyage 'Rabaul'.
entries.reason: Kept; base passes the name test (see destinations-proposed.json name_evidence) and has the spots to fill a visit.

entries.name: Tavurvur
entries.note: Volcano: active stratovolcano above Rabaul with a drive-up parking point, hot springs and ash views; Wikivoyage 'See' item 1.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Kokopo
entries.note: Town: current provincial capital and airport gateway (Tokua), with markets and the Kokopo war museum; covered in Wikivoyage 'Rabaul'.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Rabaul Volcano Observatory
entries.note: Lookout: volcano observatory on Mount Tavanabatir with a view over Rabaul town, bay and volcano; Wikivoyage 'See' item 6 and 'Do' climb.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Japanese Barge Tunnel
entries.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node (Overpass) tourism=attraction "Japanese WWII Barges Tunnel"
entries.note: WWII tunnel: Japanese tunnel near Mount Vulcan with barges still inside at Karavia; Wikivoyage 'See' item 3.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: New Guinea Club Museum
entries.note: Museum: 1937 New Guinea Club building now a museum of Rabaul's history, with photographs; Wikivoyage 'See' item 5.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Bitapaka War Cemetery
entries.note: War cemetery: Australian War Graves Commission cemetery for WWII servicemen of many nations, with a Japanese war memorial; Wikivoyage 'See' item 2.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Kokopo War and Cultural Museum
entries.note: Museum: Japanese war relics and photographs in central Kokopo; Wikivoyage 'See' item 7.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Duke of York Islands
entries.note: Island group: 45 minutes by boat from Kokopo, for diving, snorkelling and picnics; PNG Tourism 'East New Britain' page.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Rabaul and reached from that base.

entries.name: Kimbe
entries.note: Town: capital of West New Britain on Kimbe Bay, main gateway and base for diving; Wikivoyage 'Kimbe'.
entries.reason: Kimbe, Kimbe Bay and Garbuna Volcano are three kept places: below four, standalone.

entries.name: Kimbe Bay
entries.note: Dive area: bay with 400+ coral and 900+ fish species, WWII wrecks and dolphins; Wikivoyage 'Kimbe' Do (diving).
entries.reason: Three-place cluster: standalone. Bay centroid (water) is fine for a dive area.

entries.name: Garbuna Volcano
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Volcano: still-active volcano near Hoskins with trekking and geothermal features; PNG Tourism West New Britain page.

reviews.name: Vulcan
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Rabaul names it only as the second erupting volcano (Understand, Do climb); rule 2 access and any visit unclear.
reviews.skeptic_objection: Case for: active volcano above Rabaul; against: no listing says how to see or climb it, and the Barge Tunnel and Rabaul Tours already bring visitors to its flank.

reviews.name: Mount Mother
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do names the climb (700 m, from Matalau Village, early morning); a real half-day-plus activity.
reviews.skeptic_objection: Case against: one source, no route details, guide probably needed, no coordinates; case for: highest hill around Simpson Harbour.

reviews.name: Japanese Wrecks, Simpson Harbour
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do (dive) names sunken Japanese ships; rule 2 only divers can see them and no single site is pinned.
reviews.skeptic_objection: Case for: a headline reason divers go to Rabaul; against: a dive activity, no specific named wreck or point, operator dependent.

reviews.name: General Yamamoto's Bunker
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage See item 4, K5 underground command post; rule 2 visit is short.
reviews.skeptic_objection: Wikivoyage itself says it is small and there's nothing in it; for: a named WWII site that visitors enter, next to the New Guinea Club.

reviews.name: Kokopo Market
reviews.reason: Rule 1: named by Wikivoyage Buy and PNG Tourism ('stroll through the Kokopo markets'); rule 4 trading days not stated in either source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: If it runs most days it is fine; if it is a weekly market it fails.

reviews.name: Baining Mountains
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage PNG 'The Islands' names the forest, trails, hot springs and mud holes; rule 3 a range, not one point.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: the one place the fire dance villages and trails sit; against: a range with no single entrance, one source.

reviews.name: Mount Ulawun
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism West New Britain names it as one of PNG's most prominent peaks; rule 2 how visitors see or climb it is unstated.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: 7.6k views and a clear landmark volcano; against: remote, active, no visit details, one source.

reviews.name: Garu Hot Springs
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism West New Britain gives only photo captions (Garu volcanic site, hot springs in Talasea).
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a natural feature of a district the page tells visitors to visit; against: no description of access or a visit.

reviews.name: Lockheed Ventura Wreck
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism lists 'Tour the Lockheed Ventura' under top activities; a WWII wreck in Talasea foothills.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a named, tourable site; against: single source, remote, no coordinates.

reviews.name: Kimbe Town Market
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism West New Britain names it for produce and handicrafts; rule 4 trading days not stated.
reviews.skeptic_objection: If daily it qualifies; the source gives no days and the pin is the town centre.

reviews.name: Muruk Cave
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism names the deepest recorded cave system in the southern hemisphere in the Nakanai area; rule 2 access is expedition caving.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a headline natural feature on the official page; against: not a half-hour visit, no coordinates or access details.

note: PNG has no existing destinations or spots. Placement run jointly for all nine regions; proposed destinations are in curation/png/destinations-proposed.json.
